patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Fell off his bike, hit his head
presentation.quote: I wiped out on my bike and hit my head — I wasn't wearing my helmet. I felt okay at first, but now I've thrown up twice and I'm really sleepy and my head is pounding.
presentation.triageNote: 10-year-old male who struck his head in an unhelmeted bicycle fall. He initially seemed well but has since vomited repeatedly and become increasingly drowsy with a worsening headache.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because worsening neurologic symptoms after an unhelmeted head injury require rapid evaluation for intracranial bleeding.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This child initially appeared well after striking his head but now has repeated vomiting, increasing drowsiness, severe headache, and relative bradycardia.
clinical.acuityReason: A deteriorating course after a possible lucid interval is high risk even without current hypoxia or hypotension.
expectedResources: Immediate neurologic reassessment and serial checks
Neurosurgical consultation if bleeding is identified
keyFindings: Unhelmeted bicycle fall with head strike
teachingPoints: Clinical deterioration after a symptom-free interval can indicate expanding intracranial hemorrhage.
A normal early appearance does not end the observation or assessment.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Urgent imaging and serial neurologic assessment would determine whether observation, admission, or neurosurgical treatment is required.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 10-year-old boy, scraped up, no helmet (helmet lying beside him)
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped in the chair, holding his head
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 10-year-old boy, scraped up, a bike helmet lying unused beside him, slumped on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped, holding his head with one hand. Expression: drowsy, pained, and pale. Clearly visible: a hand holding his head, road-rash scrapes on one arm, a drowsy heavy-eyed look. No text, no logos.
